# Fresh Bites, Clean Mediterranean Cusine

> Lebanese Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Shawarma, kefta and gyro cooked fresh to order, with a big side salad, hummus and pita, from a family that has served Tampa since 2012.

- Phone: (813) 336-4936
- Address: 11665 Countryway Blvd, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Shawarma, kefta and gyro; Wraps and salads; Falafel and mezze
- Rating: 4.7 from 615 Google reviews
